run_musan_preparation: run the MUSAN audio preparation pipeline to split, mix, and count frames for a dataset root
split_musan_audio: split long WAV audio files into 10-second segments across speech, music, and noise directories
mix_audio_files: mix multiple WAV audio files together by averaging their samples and returning the result
get_speaker_info: extract speaker IDs from WAV filenames and split them into train, valid, and test sets
make_musan_babble: generate babble audio mixtures by randomly mixing 30 speaker utterances for train, valid, and test splits
